sinopsis.es: La desaparición de Natalia, de 19 años, sacude a Pueblo Blanco. La búsqueda lleva a las autoridades a un bar clandestino donde dos hermanas sobreviven al abuso de su tío y de una clientela perversa. Cuando ellas ayudan a un hombre extraño hallado en el bosque, desatan una cadena de violencia y rituales, y el pueblo cae presa de una oscura secta.
sinopsis.en: The disappearance of Natalia, a 19-year-old, shakes Pueblo Blanco. In their search, the authorities reach a clandestine bar where two sisters survive the abuse of their uncle and a perverse clientele. When they decide to help a strange man found in the forest, they unleash a chain of violence and rituals in which the inspector, his partner and the townspeople themselves fall prey to death and to a dark sect. Amid the horror, one latent truth remains: what dwells in the darkness… once asked for help too.
